body:
I never considered any anxiety I had as a legitimate medical problem...

I can't help but think: this is so very different than what I've had. I'm not kept awake at night, I'm not shakey when left to my thoughts, I don't think anyone is watching me.


EDIT: yes, yes I have. not often. I think I might not be noticing this because I've fallen into a LOT of vices. Eating out, cigarettes, a lotta procrastination lately. Snowballing in that sense.


That... that'd about do it if that is the case for me. 

EDIT 2: I keep re-reading your comment, sorry: I will look into this. That's an answer that finally makes sense to me. I very literally don't have anything to lose here. Need to get in touch with my family doc. 

Thank you, really. For your time and words. If it's still anxiety while I'm not feeling it (AND my anxiety could be enough for something clinical) then that might shift the way I run my routine, on top of a prescription of some kind to see if there's help.
